text:
Ethan (AE): FYI customer (big fintech) asking for: SOC2 control excerpt (scoped to infra/ops), a signed pen-test attestation letter, and an evidence drop for recent access logs + config snapshots. They prefer SCP/SFTP into a customer-specific drop. Timeline: want it by COB Fri.

Roshni (Solutions): We usually do presigned S3 plus an SFTP gateway only if customers insist. We can provide a temporary bucket with IP restriction + object lifecycle (7 days). If they need on-prem transfer we can provide scp over bastion but that needs ops approval.

Ethan (AE): They explicitly asked for an "SFTP endpoint into staging" and insist on seeing proof of SOC2 scoping text.

Mateo (Security): Requirements from security side: redact all PAN/SSNs, remove full hostnames (mask), PVs of tokens removed, provide SHA256 sums, and a brief attestation from the customer that they performed their own redaction. We also require the pen-test attestation to be high-level (date, firm, letterhead, statement that tests were executed, no raw exploit details).

Tanya (RevOps): Pricing: short-lived dedicated POC (3 days of reserved inference nodes + secure ingestion) = estimate +$2,200. Adding managed SFTP gateway + 24/7 upload monitoring = +$450. Presigned links only saves ~ $350. Quote will be attached.

Noah (Legal): I'll need to see the customer's intended recipient for the evidence and whether they want us to sign a mutual NDA or a limited DPA. For pen-test letter: we can provide a signed attestation confirming we do regular pen-tests, but we cannot disclose tooling or internal findings. We can share a redacted SOC2 excerpt (controls mapping) under NDA.

Ethan (AE): Action items: Roshni to confirm upload mechanism today, Mateo to post the redaction checklist and allowed formats, Tanya to produce a short quote, Noah to prepare the NDA/DPA note. I'll get CIDRs and preferred upload window from the customer.

sftp-bot: Automated: secure-bucket/poc-2865432100 created; lifecycle policy: expire objects after 7 days.

Roshni (Solutions): Ops says presigned links ok. I'll publish a small bash helper for the customer to upload multiple files safely (we will impose 1.5GB per part limit). Example:

```
# upload.sh
for file in "$@"; do
  url=$(curl -s "https://internal-api/presign?file=$(basename $file)")
  curl -X PUT "$url" -T "$file" -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream"
done
```

Mateo (Security): Redaction checklist (short):
- Remove/ mask PII (names, emails, SSNs, PANs)
- Strip full IPs or replace with x.x.x.x notation
- Remove API keys/secret tokens
- PDFs: remove embedded metadata and comments
- Allowed types: .log .txt .json .zip .pdf
- Max per-file: 1.5GB (split archives if needed)
- Provide checksums (sha256) and a manifest.csv

Tanya (RevOps): Quote link: https://redwood-internal/quotes/poctemp-2865432100 (internal). Pricing includes S3 storage cost and short-term reserved instances.

Noah (Legal): Draft NDA + DPA note uploaded to drive. If they want SOC2 artifacts we insist on a signed NDA first. I can also prepare a one-paragraph pen-test attestation template we can sign.

Ethan (AE): Sending the ask to the customer now. If they push back on NDA requirement I will escalate. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
